summary: the row of pagecache_ring_hosttest.c, a compile's lookups over the ring with the manual staged, with the page cache cut to 1024 slots in a private copy of rach2/sys/mm/pagecache.h

argv:
set -eu
t=${WORK}/tree
sh tests/proofs/tree.sh "$t" ${SRC} rach2/sys tests/host
cd "$t"
s=rach2/sys
exec ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -g -O1 -ffreestanding -Wno-empty-body -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I $s -I $s/lib -I $s/proc tests/host/pagecache_ring_hosttest.c -o ${WORK}/pagecache_ring_hosttest

faults.name: slots-1024
faults.summary: a page cache of 1024 slots, where every round reads the disk again

lines: pagecache_ring_hosttest: FAIL: at PC_SLOTS a compile's lookups over the ring with the manual read nothing from the disk once warm
